privacy_my_data: What data is stored about me?
privacy_my_data_note: Access request under Art. 15 GDPR. The export below contains this data in full and in machine-readable form (Art. 20).
privacy_nothing: Nothing on file apart from the user account.
privacy_export_note: Contains all data stored about you. Password hashes are deliberately excluded – they are not subject to access requests and disclosing them would be a security risk.
privacy_erase_note: Art. 17 GDPR. The request is not carried out immediately but reviewed – Art. 17(3) allows exceptions, for example where record-keeping duties apply. Handled within one month (Art. 12(3)).
privacy_erase_pending: A request from {date} is on file and under review.
privacy_erase_q_note: The request will be reviewed by administrators and answered within one month.
privacy_retention_note: Art. 5(1)(e) GDPR – data may only be kept as long as it is needed. 0 = unlimited; that should be a justified decision, not an oversight. Retention periods are applied automatically every day.
privacy_purge_note: Expired data will be permanently removed or anonymised.
privacy_rec_note: Screen and terminal recordings are the most intrusive data this system holds. They show concrete behaviour at the workplace – short retention and a small circle of authorised viewers matter more here than anywhere else.
privacy_stock_note: This overview helps with the record of processing activities (Art. 30) – but does not replace it: that record also needs purpose, legal basis and recipients for each processing operation.
privacy_reject_hint: Art. 12(4) GDPR – data subjects must be told the reasons. Required.
privacy_persons: Access and erasure for individual people
privacy_persons_note: Every access to another person's data is recorded in the audit log. Only provide information on an actual request by the data subject – this is not a general right of inspection.
privacy_erase_how_note:
ANONYMISE (recommended): records with an evidential function are kept, the link to the person is severed. Covers Art. 17 while respecting the exceptions in paragraph 3.

COMPLETE: everything is removed, including this person's audit entries. Only choose this if no record-keeping duty applies.
privacy_hard_note: Irreversible. This person's audit entries will disappear too.
